'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Mitch Nieland LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Dos mas!. Mitch Nieland, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2013 form. Username blank.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
